name: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd
title: Sterling and Wilson Renewable Energy Ltd - 542760 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Record FY26 turnover INR 7,548 cr and UOV above INR 11,800 cr, but Q4 revenue fell to INR 1,946 cr as developers deferred ordering, and EPC margin guide held at 8-10%.

triggers.label: Q4 order inflow muted, shifted to Q1
triggers.quote: EPC ordering activities by developers in the fourth quarter was largely muted.

triggers.label: Q4 revenue drop from deferred supplies
triggers.quote: Company had to defer some of the supplies and revised the execution plans accordingly in Q4 FY26

triggers.label: Revenue growth ~15% targeted for FY27
triggers.quote: we'll definitely be growing at a reasonably, let's say, 15% I mean, growth, yes.

triggers.label: Gross margin on international EPC 13.2%
triggers.quote: margins reflated to 13.2% versus 8% in FY25

guidance.quote: we'll definitely be growing at a reasonably, let's say, 15% I mean, growth, yes.
we anticipate EPC gross margins to range between 8% to 10%, depending on whether they are turnkey or BOS orders.
On the O&M side, we expect the gross margin to stabilize at around 20% level.

red_flags.label: Open-ended US litigation exposure beyond INR200 cr
red_flags.quote: Could be more, in fact. We'll come back to you.

red_flags.label: Q4 margin spike from one-off savings
red_flags.quote: there were certain savings over the budgeted cost that has improved our overall margin

red_flags.label: Reliance order timing unclear
red_flags.quote: I will say no comment at this point.

evasions.topic: Reliance New Energy timing and margins
evasions.quote: So all terms and conditions, everything are yet to be decided, discussed. So at this moment, I can't tell you any number.
Since it is a court case -- we are not considering that we will be losing the case and therefore, no provision to be made at this stage.
It may not be happening in maybe this financial year.
